title: Fuzzer: `Animation.track_move_up` crashes Godot

### Steps to reproduce

Run this script:

```gdscript
extends Node

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	for i in get_children():
		i.queue_free()

	var temp_variable12 = Animation.new()
	temp_variable12.track_move_up(-65)

	get_tree().quit()
```

Or use the attached `mrp.zip`:

```
godot --headless --path mrp/ Node.tscn
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29937118/mrp.zip)
